summary: Master the art of Evidence-Based Decision Making. Join our course to learn how to leverage data for effective recommendations and improved decision-making.
lede: Evidence-based decision-making training is for professionals who must justify strategic choices and resource allocations with evidence. It covers framing operational problems and judging data quality, comparing options with structured methods such as the Analytic Hierarchy Process, and assessing uncertainty with sensitivity analysis. Participants also practice presenting findings as clear recommendations for stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who must justify strategic choices and resource allocations using rigorous data and logical frameworks.
audience: Human Resources Business Partners using workforce analytics
modules: Integration and the Strategic Decision Dashboard
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a management, analytical, or advisory role. A basic understanding of business statistics (mean, median, standard deviation) and proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required. No prior programming or coding knowledge is necessary.
